content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Alignment Workshop: Enhanced Security Protocols for European Logistics Hubs
agenda_items: Resource allocation and budgeting for initial pilot program
Review of current security vulnerabilities in European logistics network
Discussion on operational impact and integration challenges of new security measures
Defining key performance indicators (KPIs) for security effectiveness
key_decisions: Allocate a dedicated budget for security infrastructure upgrades as part of the next fiscal planning cycle.
Form a cross-functional working group to assess blockchain feasibility for sensitive cargo tracking within the next 4 weeks.
attendees: Dr. Anja Richter, Head of European Logistics
Ms. Isabelle Dubois, Head of Supply Chain Strategy
Mr. Lars Johannsen, Operations Director (North Europe)
